# `gcp.tagbinding`

A TagBinding represents a connection between a TagValue and a cloud resource (currently project, folder, or organization). Once a TagBinding is created, the TagValue is applied to all the descendants of the cloud resource.

[cloudresourcemanager](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/TagBinding` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: tagBindings has create, delete and list but no get and no patch (checked against the cloudresourcemanager v3 Discovery document, 2026-09-21). Read is therefore a list filtered by parent, and every field is ForceNew because there is no update path at all. Required at v1.0 by spec decision G6.
pre_create rewrites tag_value onto one of two wire fields depending on its VALUE at runtime: a "tagValues/{id}"-prefixed string is sent as tagValue unchanged (exactly what the generic path already does), but a namespaced short-name string (e.g. "myorg/env/prod") is instead meant to go out as tagValueNamespacedName, which the generic path has no way to produce. Accepted for v1.0 with a known, bounded gap: a config that writes tag_value in tagValues/{id} form (the common, unambiguous form, and the only one gcp.tagvalue's own self_link produces) behaves identically to the real hook; a config using the namespaced short-name form will send it verbatim as tagValue instead. We EXPECT the real API to reject that rather than silently misapply it, but this is an ASSUMPTION, not something verified against a live project — nothing in this codebase has touched real GCP yet (that begins at Task 18). Task 18's live suite should confirm it; if the API instead accepts a namespaced value under the wrong key and does something else with it, this ruling is wrong and needs revisiting, not just this note.
custom_import only affects `terraform import`'s own ID parsing, which infrena does not consume (Import here goes through read_via, not this hook) — recorded for completeness, not because it does anything on infrena's wire.

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST tagBindings` |
| Read | yes | by `list_by_parent`: `GET tagBindings/{+name}` |
| Update | **no** | publishes no update method; every change to it replaces the resource |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE tagBindings/{+name}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |

## Import id

Any one of these shapes is accepted, tried in order:

```
tagBindings/{+name}
tagBindings/{{name}}
{{name}}
```
